audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Gwen/Skill/Shen/Shen/Gwen/Shen/Shen while the page's own prose says the lane tilts to Gwen at 3, 'This is where you take over' at 4-6, and 'You win the straight 1v1 all game'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen and matches the prose and the 53.28% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text with no timings.
audit.why: Real spikes: Shadow Dash coming online, Gwen's Level 3 Q+E, Riftmaker, and Shen's Stand United at 160-200s.
audit.corrected: Every phase why now names the ability and its cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never stated what Spirit's Refuge actually blocks, and told you to 'Snip his HP' with no reason it works.
audit.why: Riot: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.' It blocks basic attacks only — so your autos and the A Thousand Cuts on-hit proc are denied inside it, while Snip Snip! and Needlework are abilities and land through it. Snip Snip! also deals true damage in the centre, which his armour stack cannot reduce.
audit.corrected: Attacks-not-abilities written into the phase whys, cooldown block, dos/donts and the interactions row.

audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s at 600 range — the longest engage cooldown in the lane and the whole trade window.

edits.before: Stack snips on the wave and tag him with the true-damage center. Identify how Shen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks near his spirit blade — your autos and A Thousand Cuts die in it, but Snip Snip! is an ability and lands anyway.

edits.before: E dash-attack-speed makes the snip window real. Only take the trade when Shen's Shadow Dash is down.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash opens the window, but Shadow Dash is 18s of taunt at rank 1 — do not step in while it is up.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Shen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Q+E online. Snip Snip! is %-max-HP magic with a true-damage centre, so his armour stack does nothing about it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shadow Dash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is gone 18s at rank 1 and 14s at rank 3 — that is your whole trade window. Bait the taunt, then poke-and-reset with Skip 'n Slash.

edits.before: Needles ramp the longer the fight goes — extended brawls are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Shen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Needlework ramps over three casts; drop Hallowed Mist as his taunt lands so the Twilight Assault follow-up whiffs into the fog.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shadow Dash's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker is your spike — the more armour he stacks, the harder %-max-HP snips land.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Shen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, you own the 1v1 forever. The danger is Stand United at 160-200s — ping it up so it cannot bail a lost fight.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash (10-18s): his only engage and his taunt — dodge it and the fight is yours. - Spirit's Refuge (10-16s): blocks attacks, not abilities, so Q through it. - Needlework: kill windows only.

edits.before: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Shen with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Shen wastes Shadow Dash (Taunt) — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Good trade: Stack passive on minions, E onto Shen with the center-Q ready, snip the %HP true damage, and W if he turns. Great trade: Shadow Dash whiffs — he has no engage for up to 18s, so commit the full pattern. Bad trade: standing in Spirit's Refuge trading autos, where every basic attack of yours is blocked and A Thousand Cuts never procs.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His taunt and his only engage, 10-18s. Engage once it is baited.

edits.before: Shen wastes Shadow Dash (Taunt) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Snip Snip! is an ability — Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, so it lands.

edits.before: That is Shen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks, so A Thousand Cuts never procs there.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 600 range — respect it from further than you think.

edits.before: Dropping W early or fighting outside it against his key tool — the mist IS the matchup for ranged answers.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 18-22s and it is what makes his taunt commit whiff — never spend it on chip damage.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities: your autos die in it, Snip Snip! and Needlework do not.

notes: Stored chart contradicted the page's own prose in five of seven rows; realigned to the packet. The load-bearing fact — Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only, so Snip Snip! and Needlework pass through it while A Thousand Cuts does not proc — was missing from the full layer entirely.
